exposure: Change in serum b-hCG between day 1 and day 4 after methotrexate (MTX) treatment
outcome: Early treatment failure of single-dose methotrexate for ectopic pregnancy (defined as need for surgery or additional MTX doses)
cohort: The study included 1120 patients diagnosed with ectopic pregnancies (EPs) who were treated with a single dose of methotrexate (MTX).
finding: An increase in serum b-hCG of more than 19% in the 48 hours before treatment and an increase of more than 36% between day 1 and day 4 after MTX treatment are significant predictors of early treatment failure for ectopic pregnancy.
followup_time: Early period, up to 4 days post-treatment for primary measurements used in prediction
